title: 2026-11-09 abstract-edge-search pre-registration

account.day_trades: 0 by construction (all holds overnight); guard counted for options
account.spy_benchmark_exception: SPY buy-hold at 100% is a labelled benchmark exception

engine.options: Options/Validate10k.py RunOptions2 with FILL_MODEL=v3 (ITM_FRAC central 0.10, stress 0.25), raw strikes, real ticks, split exclusion, dividends
engine.shares: yfinance auto-adjusted (split+div) daily open/close; signals from close t-1, fills at open t; slippage 5 bps x cost_mult per side

evaluation.bootstrap: stationary/circular block bootstrap, 21-session blocks, 2000 reps, one-sided p for mean daily excess return > 0
evaluation.multiple_testing: Bonferroni over the 15 primary configurations: alpha = 0.05/15 = 0.00333
evaluation.windows: all 2012-2026 (or 2015-2026 for train-selected F1) = RETROSPECTIVE VALIDATION, not out-of-sample
evaluation.start_date_sensitivity: CAGR from Jan of each start year 2012..2022 to 2026-11-06

two_questions_kept_separate.absolute: CAGR > 0 and final equity > $10,000 at cost 2
two_questions_kept_separate.risk_adjusted_outperformance: annualised mean daily return minus vol-matched SPY (SPY+cash scaled to the strategy's realised vol), bootstrap p

evaluation.pass_rule: a primary PASSES only if ALL: (1) absolute CAGR > cash 2% at cost 2 AND cost 3; (2) outperformance vs vol-matched SPY > 0 with bootstrap p < 0.00333; (3) CAGR > 0 in >= 2/3 of start years; (4) every registered neighbor/phase has same-sign outperformance; (5) for options families, survives IVRP 1.0 and ITM_FRAC 0.25 stress with CAGR > 0

F1_inverse.mechanism: if a strategy loses for a structural reason (paying a premium/negative drift), its counterparty side may earn it; but friction is paid on BOTH sides, so inverse only works if gross edge of the original < -2x friction
F1_inverse.universe: 11 Validate10k structures; inverse allowed only if defined-risk and no short stock (straddle/long single-option/covered_call inverses excluded)
F1_inverse.selection: each test year Y in 2015..2026: rank ORIGINAL structures by CAGR over 2012-01-03..(Y-1)-12-31 at cost 2 (train only); trade the inverse in year Y

primaries.F1a: literal inverse (all leg quantities negated, same entry signal) of the train-worst inverse-eligible structure
primaries.F1b: equal-weight daily-return blend of the inverses of the train-worst 3 inverse-eligible structures
primaries.F1c: opposite-signal: same legs as the train-worst directional (bull/bear) structure, entered on the OPPOSITE trend signal
primaries.F1d: opposite-signal shares: long-only, equal weight (<=50%) tickers in a BEAR trend state (close<SMA50 and 63d return<0), biweekly Mon/even phase

diagnostics_not_primaries: cost_mult 0 (frictionless) original vs inverse CAGR for every eligible structure
IVRP 1.0 / 1.25 and ITM_FRAC 0.25 rerun of the selected inverses
all 10 weekday x parity phases for F1d

F2_trend_voltarget.mechanism: time-series momentum (slow-moving risk premia / underreaction) and volatility clustering (vol targeting lowers exposure in turbulent regimes)
F2_trend_voltarget.rule: monthly at the open of the first session with day-of-month >= offset; asset eligible if Close(t-1-21)/Close(t-1-L) - 1 > 0; weights proportional to 1/vol60; whole book scaled so ex-ante vol (60d covariance at t-1) = target; per-ticker cap 50%, gross <= 100%, rest cash

F3_vrp_gated_spy_options.mechanism: variance risk premium: implied vol usually exceeds subsequent realized; sell when the ex-ante premium is large, buy convexity when implied is cheap vs recent realized
F3_vrp_gated_spy_options.data: REAL ex-ante implied vol: Cboe VIX9D close (yfinance ^VIX9D, 2011-01-04..) used as SPY ATM IV at entry (close t-1) and at marks (close t); skew 0.10 ASSUMED; spreads/fees ASSUMED (cost 1/2/3); SPX index vol applied to SPY (assumption)
F3_vrp_gated_spy_options.gate: ratio = VIX9D(t-1)/100 / RV20(t-1), RV20 = sqrt(252)*stdev of last 20 SPY log returns

primaries.F3b: bull_put_credit only when ratio >= 1.25 (and bull trend)
primaries.F3f: underlying analog: hold SPY 50% when ratio(t-1) >= 1.0 else cash, decided at close t-1, traded at open t

F3_vrp_gated_spy_options.stress: assignment/pin: count short legs ITM with extrinsic < tick near expiry; ITM_FRAC 0.25; skew 0.05/0.15 noted as untested

F4_turn_of_month.mechanism: month-end/month-start flows (payroll, pension and fund rebalancing) documented since Ariel (1987) / Lakonishok-Smidt (1988)
F4_turn_of_month.rule: hold SPY/QQQ/IWM at 1/3 each from the OPEN of the last session of month m to the OPEN of the 4th session of month m+1; cash otherwise
F4_turn_of_month.control: same exposure-time fraction of SPY via vol-matched SPY; random-month-window placebo (same window length, 500 draws)

not_testable_declared: true option edge on single names (no historical quotes/IV)
short-dated (<1w) SPY options gating (VIX9D is 9-day; ok for 2w but extrapolated)

repairs_registered.fill_v3: half-spread pct on extrinsic + ITM_FRAC x intrinsic; exercise floor for selling long ITM legs; v2 retained as legacy
repairs_registered.earnings_timing: EDGAR 8-K Item 2.02 acceptance timestamps; ambiguous/6-K-only/no-match excluded; price reaction never consulted

prospective_paper_test_rule: named in findings; NOT started or scheduled
